submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 3 mm plate thickness is recommended as the optimal configuration for the forward electromagnetic calorimeter. This material meets all hard requirements while delivering the best energy resolution among viable options. F2 has a residual dose rate of 12 μSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown, safely below the 20 μSv/h limit for hands-on maintenance. While Absorber-F1 was excluded due to its excessive activation dose rate of 85 μSv/h, both F2 and F3 (6 μSv/h) meet the radiation safety constraint. Among these two viable materials, F2 achieves superior energy resolution at 100 GeV, making it the optimal choice. The 3 mm plate thickness was determined through simulation optimization to provide the best energy resolution within the allowed 2-10 mm range.
